inspector.sinVistaRica: Species, lineage and relatives are shown with the enriched view.
inspector.seguir.ayuda: The camera stays with the bot (dragging the world releases it)
inspector.seguir.noDisponible: Following is controlled from the world
inspector.familia.ayuda: Highlights the bot's descendants in the world and lists its living relatives
inspector.gendist.ayuda: Colors every bot by how much its DNA differs from this bot's
inspector.murio.detalle: The data stays as it was in its last cycle.
inspector.noReproducible: This writes to this bot's memory and is not kept in the run: replicas and «Repeat» do not repeat it.
inspector.pb.ayuda: The selected bot aims at the pointer over the world, and each key writes its value to memory while held (or while released, if inverted). Children born while you control it are highlighted and controlled too; if the bot dies, the control passes to one of them. Click another bot to hand it the control; Esc exits and clears the highlights.
inspector.pb.f1: Not available during an F1 contest.
inspector.pb.noSePuede: It cannot be turned on now (no simulation, or an F1 contest is running).
inspector.pb.memoria.ayuda: Memory location (1 to 999) or a sysvar name, such as .up
inspector.pb.invertida.ayuda: Writes the value while the key is released
inspector.pb.cambiarTecla: Choose the key: click and press one
inspector.pb.cambiarTeclaDe: Key {tecla}: click and press another one to change it
inspector.pb.memoria.derecha: Memory location 4: pushes the bot to its right
inspector.pb.memoria.izquierda: Memory location 3: pushes the bot to its left
inspector.pb.cargadoOmitidas: Preset loaded: {n} keys. {m} were skipped because their key codes are not recognised by this interface ({codigos}).
inspector.pb.invalidas: Some rows are incomplete or invalid: the keys do not change until they are fixed.
inspector.pb.nadaQueGuardar: There are no keys to save.
inspector.pb.omitidas: These keys do not fit in a .pbkp preset and were not saved: {teclas}
inspector.pb.archivoInvalido: The file is not a valid key preset (.pbkp).
inspector.ojos.ayuda: Direction and width of the bot's 9 eyes. Each change is written to its memory at once; the fan shows the effect.
inspector.ojos.f1: Not available during an F1 contest.
inspector.ojos.avisoTorneo: While a tournament is in progress the Player Bot is not offered and you can't change the eyes, the aim or the ease-of-access options: that would alter the fight. You can read the eyes and build the gene.
inspector.ojos.adnAyuda: A gene that sets these eyes at birth. Add it at the end of the bot's DNA.
inspector.ojos.abrirAyuda: Copies the gene and opens the editor of this bot of yours: paste it at the end
inspector.ojos.noCopiado: Could not copy: select the text and copy it by hand.
inspector.ojos.sinCostos.ayuda: Sets the cost multiplier to 0 (live change: kept in the run)
inspector.ojos.punteria.ayuda: Writes 0 to this bot's .setaim (not kept in the run)
inspector.ojos.sinBrowniano.ayuda: Sets Brownian motion to 0 (live change: kept in the run)
inspector.ojos.noAplicado: The change could not be applied.
inspector.recursos.ayuda: {sysvar}: the bar is relative to the maximum among living bots ({max})
inspector.energia.sinDatos: Collecting data: the curve shows up after a few cycles.
inspector.familia.descendientes: {n} living descendants · {m} highlighted in the world
inspector.sentidos.fan: Field of view of the 9 eyes; the focus eye is red
inspector.sentidos.sinFoco: Waiting for the first cycle with the bot selected…
inspector.memoria.ayuda: Values from the bot's memory, read again every half second.
inspector.memoria.invalida: Type a sysvar (.nrg) or an address from 1 to 999.
inspector.adn.releer.ayuda: Asks for the DNA again (it may have mutated)
inspector.consola.ayudaCorta: Type help to see the commands.
inspector.consola.adnEnPestana: The DNA is in the DNA tab.
inspector.consola.cerrada: The console closed: the bot died.
inspector.consola.avisoTorneo: While a tournament is in progress the console is read-only: set, energy, cycle, execrob, play and pause are not sent.
inspector.consola.soloLectura: {verbo}: not available while a tournament is in progress (it would alter the fight).
inspector.consola.ayuda.intro: The console reads and changes this bot's memory. Active genes are refreshed after every command.
inspector.consola.ayuda.printmem: value of .var or of address n
inspector.consola.ayuda.set: stores v in .var or at address n
inspector.consola.ayuda.energy: sets the bot's energy to e
inspector.consola.ayuda.execrob: runs every bot without advancing the cycle
inspector.consola.ayuda.debug: interpreter trace of the last cycle
inspector.ayuda: Open the inspector's page in the manual
